012.name: Between Human and Yokai
012.0: Hmph, it's a clear fact that Yokai cannot coexist with Humans...
012.1: I believe that someday Humans and Yokai will get along.
012.2: Sooooo.... By that logic, how do you coexist with your sister?

013.name: Damsels and Detectives
013.0: What do you want with my sister, old-manbaby?
013.1: I'm grateful I have both of you to take care of me.
013.3: I'll tolerate that because Takeno is here...

014.name: Stilted Romance
014.0: Why is he always bothering Takeno?
014.1: I think Nue is just being nice because he's a good person.

015.name: Flowers and Fiends
015.0: I don't care what some Yokai thinks.
015.1: I hate it when you talk like that...
015.5: Everyone has their own tragedy. Get over yourself.

016.name: Bound By Duty
016.0: Why are you worrying over some Fox?
016.1: I'm happy that Kurama is no longer a hermit.
016.6: Are you really sisters? You seem like complete opposites!

017.name: Zipangu Flowers
017.0: Isn't Takeno the prettiest in all of Zipangu?
017.1: No, no... I think Kino and Izuna are prettier.
017.7: Girls, please. Let's not fight over who's prettiest. I don't want to hurt anyone's feelings.

018.name: Great Benefactor
018.1: I wouldn't be here today if it weren't for Tengu's help.

019.name: Bickering Beauties
019.0: Takeno doesn't have to listen to some kid like you.
019.1: If I was healthy everyone wouldn't have to fuss over me.
019.9: After everything, a bunch of Yokai have done more for your sister than you!

023.name: More than Meets the Eye
023.0: I can't tell if you're both acting or just really weird.
023.2: I'm a man of many mysteries!
023.3: I'm not gonna take any guff from you, kid!

024.name: An Unlikely Bunch
024.0: Takeno doesn't need any of you when she's got me!
024.2: You just keep telling yourself that, buddy.
024.4: Even if you're right... I'm not won't give up on her!

025.name: Stubborn By Blood
025.0: Even if Humans and Yokai are the same, my behavior was justified.
025.2: Don't sweat it. Everybody's got some kinda crippling tragedy.
025.5: Tragedy? Ibaraki had a choice, I did not.

026.name: Dumb and Dumber
026.0: I don't think you're in a position to be giving advice.

027.name: Lunch Buddies
027.0: I'm eating with two Yokai instead of my sister? I think I need a minute...
027.7: We should grab a bite together sometime!

028.name: Silence is Golden
028.0: I would not have let Ibaraki stay at the shrine if I knew he'd be this loud.
028.2: What? This is my normal speaking voice! If anything, you're talking too quiet.

029.name: Strange Companions
029.0: Yokai are so mysterious and hard to understand.
029.2: What? Humans are the weird ones!
029.9: I think Humans are strange too. Falling for an obvious ploy like Genkou's...

034.0: As Yokai go, you two are the worst of the worst.
034.3: You're welcome to hate me, but how could you lump me in with a drama-king like that kid?
034.4: Pfft. I don't care what some Human thinks.
034.name: The Insufferables

035.0: Is the old weasel trying to justify himself?
035.5: I will claim my revenge some day.
035.name: Obvious Enemies

036.0: I can't tell which of you looks younger.
036.3: Wha...? What's wrong with my face?
036.6: There's nothing wrong with being young!
036.name: Babyfaced

037.0: Why are you both always asking my sister to do things?
037.3: If she didn't want to buy me dango, she would've said something!
037.name: Possessive

038.0: Something strange is going on between you two...
038.3: Huh? What are you talking about?
038.name: Embarrassing Secrets

039.0: Why do you have the face of a child?
039.3: Heh, you're just jealous of my baby-smooth skin.
039.9: YOROZU HAS THE NICEST SKIN OF ANYONE!
039.name: Youthful Glow

045.0: Kubinashi... Why do you hang out with Nue of all people?
045.4: That's because I'm so obviously great! Muhahaha!
045.5: ...I look to the future, not the present.
045.name: Late Bloomer

046.0: You know, you two sort of look alike.
046.name: Living in Denial

047.0: Why don't you stop bothering my sister and go hang out with that Fox Yokai over there?
047.4: Izuna is also pretty but... Ta... Takeno is the only one for me!
047.name: Stubborn Love

048.0: Takeno wouldn't waste her time with either of you!
048.4: I'm a far more suitable match than some crow!
048.8: Huh? Takeno is like a little sister to me.
048.name: Love Rivals(?)

049.0: If you don't stop bugging my sister, I'm going to kick you out of the Mushroom Shrine!
049.4: Y-you can't do that! It's destiny!
049.9: Your sister isn't going to find ANYBODY with you hovering around all the time.
049.name: Overprotective

056.0: I think Kubinashi and I might actually get along if I met her before she was a creepy ghost lady.
056.5: What do you expect me to do? Travel back in time?
056.6: I wouldn't mind a do-over either...
056.name: Ancient History

057.0: I don't like how Kubinashi acts towards my sister. And Izuna's way too close!
057.name: Oversensitive

058.0: I feel like Tengu's plotting something...
058.5: That piercing gaze... It's as though he's reading my thoughts.
058.8: W-what? I think you have the wrong idea bout me.
058.name: The Misunderstanding

059.0: It's amazing that there are Yokai smarter than Humans...
059.5: Hmph. Yorozu cannot match my years of experience.
059.9: Clearly quality of study is more important than quantity. YOROZU IS SMARTER THAN YOU!
059.name: Elitist Yokai

067.0: I don't really care or anything, but... why aren't you two going out?
067.6: Heh... I like Izuna, but she can be a little scary sometimes.
067.7: Hmph! I already get enough attention.
067.name: Kooky Kids

068.0: I don't have the patience to be nice to any Yokai that isn't my sister.
068.6: This place is full of scary people!
068.name: Subjective Terror

069.0: Why does Kurama smell more like a fox than Izuna?
069.6: That's because the of the Nine-Tailed Fox is still inside me.
069.9: Yorozu will investigate the source of the Nine-Tailed Fox's power! ...REVEAL YOUR SECRETS!
069.name: Power of the Nine-Tailed Fox

078.0: Acting mature isn't proof someone's a good person.
078.7: I think Tengu still acts like a kid sometimes.
078.name: Mature Adult

079.0: I guess I can put up with anything as long as Takeno is happy...
079.7: I'm just happy that Kura is back in my life.
079.9: Yorozu's life is free of hardship as long as she has access to cucumbers and bathes regularly!
079.name: Self-Sacrifice

089.0: Don't you think Yorozu's a little young to be doing all your work for you?
089.8: Huh? But I never ask her to do anything...
089.9: Mr. Tengu's only flaw is his laziness. It's okay! YOROZU WILL DO IT!
089.name: Brutal Taskmaster

123.1: Ibaraki lost Gyuki... Would things be different if I was more self-reliant?
123.2: Don't be ridiculous. I miss Gyuki,  but what happened to him is no one's fault.
123.3: Such a tragedy should never have happened in the first place!
123.name: Condolences

124.1: I think both Ibaraki and Nue are good people.
124.2: Ugh. Please don't compare me to Nue...
124.4: Ibaraki, I challenge you to a duel!
124.name: Dangerous Attention

125.1: There's no reason for any of us to fight.
125.2: Good luck convincing Kubinashi of that.
125.5: Hmph. I don't know whether you are naive, or a fool.
125.name: Difference of Opinion

126.1: Kurama and Ibaraki are always so cheerful!
126.2: You only get one life, no point wasting time complaining!
126.name: Unjustifiably Cheerful

127.2: Hate her? She's the reason I've made so many friends!
127.7: I don't hate her. We were able to help Kurama by gathering the Five Elements.
127.name: Alternative Perspective

128.1: I am truly grateful to all those that helped me.
128.2: Takeno has a heart of gold.
128.8: I merely did what was required of me.
128.name: Gratitude

129.1: I wish all Yokai could get along with Humans like Ibaraki does.
129.2: Give it a few decades! We'll be there sooner than you think.
129.9: YOROZU DOES NOT WANT TO HANG OUT WITH SMELLY HUMANS!
129.name: Love for Humanity

134.1: I'm grateful to you both for spending so much time looking after me.
134.3: It's because you're like a daughter to me.
134.4: Get lost, creepy old weasel! Stay away from Takeno!
134.name: Questionable Motive

135.1: Kubinashi, I'm really sorry about what happened to you but... Kamaitachi regrets his actions!
135.3: I don't know how many times I've apologized!
135.5: No amount of apologies will ever be sufficient recourse for taking my life.
135.name: Accidental Murder

136.1: Kamaitachi's role as chief investigator is a great help to the Mushroom Shrine.
136.3: Heh, I'm a shining example to young Yokai everywhere!
136.6: Heh... I'm happy the way I am.
136.name: Chief Investigator Kamaitachi

137.1: I enjoy tea time with Izuna.
137.3: I like tea! How come I wasn't invited?
137.7: I always have time for tea with Takeno.
137.name: Afternoon Tea Time

138.1: I'm so thankful that Daidarabotchi sent you both to help me.
138.3: Daidarabotchi? I don't take orders from from magic spirit-ladies!
138.8: It was fate that brought us together, not Daidarabotchi.
138.name: Daidarabotchi's Will

139.1: I think Yorozu would be even cuter if she dressed more like a child.
139.3: I think Yorozu's personality is what makes her so cute.
139.9: YOROZU DOES NOT WANY ANY MORE ATTENTION!
139.name: Room for Improvement

145.1: I think Kubinashi and Nue look like a family.
145.4: Takeno Konoko... will you be my family?
145.name: Silly

146.1: My sister is my family. I don't know what I'd do without her.
146.name: Never Alone

147.1: Nue is so kind. Why don't the three of us have tea next time?
147.4: I'm only kind to you, Takeno.
147.7: Takeno is oblivious... Nue should just give up.
147.name: Nue's Kindness

148.1: Nue and Tengu are always there for me.
148.4: You! Why are you hanging around Takeno?
148.8: I think there's been a misunderstanding...
148.name: Love Triangle (?)

149.1: Do I really look like an old lady?
149.4: Takeno Konoko is p... pretty... don't listen to her words. She's just blinded by jealousy.
149.9: ANY LADY OLDER THAN YOROZU IS AN OLD LADY!
149.name: Age is a Number

156.1: Kura, are you still afraid of the Nine-Tailed Fox's power?
156.5: It's natural to be afraid of power stronger than you. There's no need to be ashamed.
156.6: The Nine-Tailed Fox is still part of me, but I'm not afraid anymore. Hehe.
156.name: A New Leaf

157.5: One of the things I miss most about being alive is hot food.
157.7: I prefer a hot glass of tea myself.
157.name: Hot Food

158.1: Tengu, what kind of person were you in the past? Where did you come from?
158.8: I committed many sins in my former life.
158.name: Shadow of a Dark Past

159.1: Yorozu, I heard you studied in Showa. Is that why you're so smart?
159.5: Is Showa known for its education programs?
159.9: Yorozu learned a lot in Showa! It's way more advanced than here!
159.name: Yorozu, Student from Showa

167.1: Back when I lived in the village, Izuna would visit me from time to time.
167.6: Is that where Izuna went at night?
167.7: I'm not like Kura, I feel cooped up spending all my time on Fox Mountain.
167.name: Izuna's Night in Town

168.1: Tengu... you always protect me without a complaint!
168.6: When I'm older I want to be like Tengu!
168.name: Better with Age

169.1: It's hard for me to feel bad about Genkou.
169.6: Ugh... And what he did to those monks...
169.9: I wouldn't be who I am today if it wasn't for Genkou's cruelty.
169.name: Genkou

178.1: You know, I don't think I've ever seen Tengu laugh.
178.7: Tengu's laughter... even I'm curious what that sounds like.
178.name: A Crow's Laughter

179.7: ARE YOU CALLING ME OLD?! How dare you? I'm not even married yet...
179.9: Yorozu doesn't want to be like you when she grows up!
179.name: Age Before Beauty

189.1: Tengu, I'm grateful for all your help.
189.8: I did no more than anyone else.
189.name: Thanks To

234.2: Somebody said Kamaitachi's scythe is made from Moonstones... Is it true?
234.3: Huh? Where did you hear that rumor?
234.4: ... (I definitely heard Yorozu say something like that...)
234.name: News Travels Fast

235.2: I'm sure Kamaitachi and Kubinashi will be able to set aside their grudge someday.
235.3: It's gonna be hard while she's trying to kill me...
235.5: I won't give up until my enemy is dead.
235.name: The Immortal Grudge

236.2: Hey Kurama, show us the Nine-Tailed Fox!
236.3: How about a duel? My scythe against your Nine-Tailed Fox?
236.6: I'm not going to awaken the Nine-Tailed Fox for your amusement!
236.name: Curiosity Kills

237.2: It's hard to find a beauty like Izuna, even in the Human world.
237.3: Wait... Are you saying some Human girls are even prettier? I'm just asking out of curiosity...
237.7: Hahaha. I was once crowned 'Miss Fox Mountain,' and I didn't even enter the contest!
237.name: Miss Fox Mountain

238.2: Kamaitachi, what's up with Tengu staring at you all the time?
238.3: What? Is Tengu out to get me like Kubinashi?
238.name: A Significant Look

239.2: Y'know, I think that between the two of you, Yorozu actually looks younger.
239.3: Hahaha! You'd better stop before you make her mad.
239.9: YOROZU WILL NOT BE ASHAMED OF HER YOUTHFUL APPEARANCE!
239.name: Yorozu and Kamaitachi

245.2: Hey, Nue I'm sorry you blew it with Takeno. Even if it was hilarious.
245.4: Ibaraki! You have to help me from now on.
245.5: Nue, this is no time for childish crushes.
245.name: The (Immature) Young Master

246.4: Don't be silly. There's no one that can beat my dazzling intellect.
246.name: 3 Idiot

247.2: Nue, what do you think of Izuna?
247.4: Izuna's beauty makes her a suitable match for someone like me.
247.7: Sorry Nue, you're not my type.
247.name: Self-Confidence

248.2: It seems Nue thinks Tengu is his rival...
248.4: I won't forgive you if you keep hanging around Takeno!
248.name: Selective Hearing

249.2: There are always a few bad apples, but most Humans are good.
249.4: You two are so nice to Humans. It's weird.
249.9: Any Human is better than a cannibalistic Yokai! That's what Yorozu thinks.
249.name: Fans of Humanity

256.2: Hey Kubinashi, do you wear that scarf because it matches your clothes?
256.5: This ribbon is dyed red with my own blood, a symbol of the revenge that is to come.
256.6: Huh? Didn't Nue say it was to cover the wound on your neck...?
256.name: Secret Of the Scarf

257.2: That hardest thing to do while pretending to be a Human is eating... Oh! But that delicious soda pop.
257.5: I haven't been able to taste anything since I died.... Kamaitachi! You will pay for this!
257.name: Same Bed, Different Dreams

258.2: Tengu's solemn attitude is a little spooky.
258.5: Isn't it better than being hopelessly sunny all the time?
258.8: Light and dark exist to give balance to one another.
258.name: Light and Darkness

259.2: (Sighs) It's hard living as a Human.
259.5: I would happily rejoin their ranks, had I the choice.
259.9: I liked the time I spent in Showa Town.
259.name: Living with Humans

267.2: Seeing Kurama and Izuna together reminds me of my friendship with Gyuki.
267.6: Izuna is more important to me than family. We grew up together.
267.name: Childhood Friends

268.8: You two are beginning to resemble one another.
268.name: Instant Friends

269.2: If Yorozu is going to act like a child, she should hang out with other kids.
269.6: She's really smart for her age.
269.name: Elegant Lady

278.2: Nice girls like Izuna should be careful around people like Tengu.
278.8: I see you're the source of the rumors...
278.name: Mudslinging

279.2: Haha, I wouldn't mind having a little sister like Yorozu, if she were a little sweeter.
279.7: You can't talk about sweetness and leave me out.
279.9: Hmph. Being sweet is just a ruse to hide one's flaws.
279.name: Sweet Izuna

289.2: Don't look at me like that, pal.
289.8: You seem to be acting as though you've done something wrong...
289.9: WHAT ARE YOU UP TO, SPIKEY HEAD?
289.name: Guilty Conscience

345.3: You're not going to start another cult up, are you Nue?
345.4: I refuse to relive the humiliation of that day, but one day I will resume preaching the TRUE gospel of Nue.
345.5: I'd rather you didn't bring it up...
345.name: One Step Forward

346.3: What's up with this generation? An angsty young narcissist, and an antisocial hermit...
346.6: Huh? Are you talking about me?
346.name: Kids These Days

347.3: There ought to be more girls out there like Izuna.
347.4: You old pervert... Are women all you think about?
347.7: Nue... you realize you spend half your time following Takeno around, right?
347.name: Hypocrisy

348.4: One day, I'll rule Zipangu... and then the world!
348.8: Take deep breaths, Kamaitachi. In, and out...
348.name: Long-term Goals

349.3: Listen kid, if we're taking bets, my money's on Yorozu.
349.4: How dare you ignore me... You'll regret it when I conquer the world!
349.9: YOROZU WILL BE A KIND AND REASONABLE LEADER, AND SHE WILL RULE WITH AN IRON FIST.
349.name: Plans for World Domination

356.3: I thought we had a truce?
356.5: I agreed to no such thing!
356.6: Kubinashi, calm down! Revenge won't get you anywhere.
356.name: Renewing the Ceasefire

357.3: I'm sorry, Izuna, but there's somebody else... Kubinashi and I...
357.5: W-what? Enough of your pranks, weasel.
357.7: What are you talkin about? I don't understand what's happening right now...
357.name: Strange Secrets

358.5: I won't accept an apology that's not from the heart.
358.8: This isn't a bad look on you, Kamaitachi.
358.name: Natural Enemies

359.3: Hey, Yorozu. Can you talk some sense into Kubinashi?
359.5: You think I'll listen if she tries to stop me?
359.9: Oh no, I think getting revenge is the right call.
359.name: Unexpected Allies

367.3: Hey, is it true you proposed to Izuna?
367.6: Eek! Who said that? That's something that happened when we were kids...
367.7: Hmph, I don't care even if he proposes 100 times.
367.name: Sleeping Dogs

368.6: Umm, I want to be like Tengu.
368.8: I am already Tengu. There is no need for another...
368.name: Tengu and Kamaitachi

369.6: She is cute with those glasses...
369.name: Yorozu - Mushroom Shrine's Idol

378.3: You kids make such a cute couple. Best of luck to you both!
378.7: (Blushes) Tengu and me? Ha-ha-ha-ha! Don't be s-silly...
378.name: Tactless Matchmaker

379.3: Hey, it's two of my favorite people!
379.name: Kamaitachi's Happy Place

389.3: My keen insight and investigative skills can't be beat!
389.8: I will not engage in pointless contests... Besides, my skills are clearly superior.
389.9: You're both being ridiculous. YOROZU DOES ALL THE LEGWORK!
389.name: Investigative Prowess

456.4: Kurama! You must have seen my greatness! You should join my order!
456.6: I... um... I have to go now.
456.name: Old Habits

457.4: I will fight every day until I win Takeno's love!
457.5: There is no greater challenge than being in love with someone oblivious.
457.7: I never realized Kurama felt that way about me... Huh? What were we talking about?
457.name: Hopeless Romantics

458.4: I must keep Tengu away from Takeno!
458.5: When will Nue return to his old self?
458.8: I do not believe his condition will simply resolve itself...
458.name: Believe What You Want

459.4: Kubinashi is a better advisor than some kid could hope to be...
459.5: Of course, I have many years of experience...
459.9: YOROZU SAYS AGE IS JUST A CONSTRUCT!
459.name: Just a Number

467.4: Takeno has not returned my feeling yet, but love is a flame that must be kindled!
467.6: The first time my heart fluttered for Izuna was under the cherry tree.
467.7: I guess women sometimes like those who like them...
467.name: Love is Fickle

468.6: Yeah! Even though he's taller, and more handsome, and has a voice like butter...
468.8: There is no need for comparisons. We each have our own merits. Besides, you cannot compare two things with such stark differences...
468.name: Clear Differences

469.4: W-what? How could you put me on the same level as Kurama?
469.6: Heheh. I don't mind being compared to Nue.
469.9: Don't you both have the same IQ?
469.name: Double Digit IQ

478.4: H-huh? A secret about Takeno that I don't know?
478.7: I know Takeno Konoko's secret. Hehe.
478.8: Izuna, please. We should not make Nue feel bad.
478.name: Takeno's Secret

479.4: Having tea with Takeno Konoko... I'm so jealous...
479.7: Hey Yorozu, want to join us for tea?
479.9: Yorozu has more important things to do with her time. Like science!
479.name: Tea Invitation

489.4: Tengu must be lazy to make Yorozu do everything for him.
489.8: An odd thing to say, for someone who preyed upon the fears of the dead.
489.9: YOROZU ONLY DOES WHAT YOROZU WANTS!
489.name: Lazy or Eager?

567.5: I'm curious... does Kurama still like Izuna?
567.6: Err... I don't want to talk about something so embarrassing...
567.7: Would things have been different if I knew how he felt before?
567.name: Opportunities Lost & Found

568.5: I wish Nue would stop following Takeno Konoko around.
568.6: Heh... Why don't you just tell Nue that?
568.8: I've tried but Nue is persistent.
568.name: Stubborn Love

569.5: Why is a smart child like Yorozu running errands for Tengu?
569.6: Those two make me feel like the dumbest person in Zipangu...
569.9: Why is a smart lady like Kubinashi working for Nue?
569.name: Personal Reasons

578.5: Life favors the strong. Fight hard, or you will be doomed to suffer.
578.8: I have found the same to be true at times...
578.name: Optimism vs. Pessimism

579.5: Consuming a warm drink feels good, even if I can't taste it.
579.7: Tea is a great way to relax!
579.9: Tea is like drinking bathtime. YOROZU IS IN HEAVEN!
579.name: Relaxing Cup of Tea

589.5: Your relationship with each other is different than the one I have with Nue.
589.8: Yorozu is not a child of my blood, but rather my sin.
589.9: Papa Tengu has always been there for Yorozu! Even if he's a little lazy...
589.name: Parental Figures

678.6: I feel like I'm so behind in life when I see Tengu. You're so put-together!
678.8: Hmm? Oh, hello. When did you both get here?
678.name: Adulthood is Subjective

679.6: I was in the top of my class when I was a kid!
679.7: You were on top because everyone else was off playing...
679.9: Certainly there are smarter people among the Fox Yokai...
679.name: Debatable Accomplishments

689.6: Ugh... I feel like a zoo animal.
689.9: QUIET! Yorozu is studying the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox.
689.name: Captive Research

789.7: T-Tengu. Why don't you have tea with us sometime?
789.8: Will Takeno be there? I would be more than happy to come.
789.9: ...Does Izuna have a thing for Mr. Tengu?
789.name: Transparent Motives
